explanation.headline: FDA's records trace our supply to a plant classified VAI 369 days before the shortage posting

sentences.text: FDA first posted the clindamycin phosphate injection shortage on 2023-03-21 and it remains current as of 2026-10-21.
The product used at Corvale East and Corvale Lakeside carries NDC 0781-3288-09 labeled by Sandoz Inc. and names InfoRLife SA as the manufacturing plant on the label.

FDA inspected a registered plant for this supply chain, Bryant Ranch PrePack (FEI 1000519407), on 2022-03-17 and classified it VAI, with the classification letter dated 2022-05-19 — 369 days before the shortage posting.
Subsequent inspections of that plant in 2023-06-16 and 2024-01-25 were also classified VAI, with classification letters issued after the shortage posting.
Another registered plant, Pharmacia & Upjohn Company LLC (FEI 1810189), was inspected on 2023-06-16 and classified VAI, 87 days after the shortage posting.
The rule-based best option is to transfer 21 bags from Corvale Lakeside to Corvale East, which would raise Corvale East to 8 days on hand.

rejected.text: Corvale East has 6.2 days of the 6 mg/mL 50 mL bags on hand while Corvale Lakeside has 19.2 days and can spare 21 bags while retaining a two-week supply.
rejected.reason: "two" is a number in words; numbers must be digits from the evidence
